Nội dung: Backend: Java 17, Spring Boot 3, Spring Cloud Gateway, Maven multi-module; Frontend: Vite, React, TypeScript; Infra: Docker Compose, nginx, ngrok; CI: GitHub Actions.
Client -> API Gateway -> microservice (content / auth / order / analytics) -> database / RabbitMQ.
Docker Compose dùng Dockerfile của từng service; api-gateway build multi-stage Maven; frontend build Vite rồi serve bằng nginx.
